flap.definition:
n. any broad thin and limber covering attached at one edge; hangs loose or projects freely
n. the motion made by flapping up and down
n. a movable piece of tissue partly connected to the body
n. a movable airfoil that is part of an aircraft wing; used to increase lift or drag
flap.translation:
n. 飘, 摆动, 拍打, 拍打声, 片状垂悬物
v. 拍打, 鼓翼而飞, 飘动

flap sb in the mouth.translation: 对某人当面撒谎,厚着脸皮对某人撒谎

flap-eared.definition: a. Having broad, loose, dependent ears.
flap-eared.translation: a. 有大耳朵的, 有垂耳的

flap-pockets.translation: (flap-pocket 的复数) 有盖袋；带盖口袋

flapdoodle.translation: n. 胡说, 梦话, 瞎话

flapjack.definition: n a flat cake of thin batter fried on both sides on a griddle
flapjack.translation: n. 烤饼, 煎饼, 小粉盒

flapjacks.definition: n. a flat cake of thin batter fried on both sides on a griddle
flapjacks.translation: n. 烙饼( flapjack的复数形式 ); 大薄煎饼; 烤饼; 小粉盒

flappable.translation: a. 容易兴奋的, 易于烦乱的

flapped.translation: v. （使）上下左右移动( flap的过去式和过去分词 ); 轻拍; 焦急, 焦虑; 振（翅）

flapper.definition: n. a young woman in the 1920s who flaunted her unconventional conduct and dress
flapper.translation: n. 拍击者, 惊鸟器, 苍蝇拍, 拍击物, (英)未入社交界的少女

flappers.definition:
plural of flapper
n. a young woman in the 1920s who flaunted her unconventional conduct and dress
flappers.translation: (flapper 的复数) n. 拍击者, 惊鸟器, 苍蝇拍, 拍击物, (英)未入社交界的少女

flapping.definition:
n the motion made by flapping up and down
v move in a wavy pattern or with a rising and falling motion
v move noisily
v move with a thrashing motion
v move with a flapping motion
v make a fuss; be agitated
v pronounce with a flap, of alveolar sounds
